blocks.text:
Today you visit Manuel Antonio National Park, in an area of tropical rainforest.

The park protects primary and secondary forest, mangroves, coastal vegetation and coral reefs.

It is home to 109 mammal species and 184 bird species. Animals you may see include badgers, two-toed and three-toed sloths, capuchins, howler monkeys and jaguars.

Birds include toucans, pelicans, green kingfishers and other species. There are also snakes, lizards and many insects.

After the nature walk, you can spend time on the park's beaches.

Accommodation at Parador Resort & Spa.

Breakfast is included.
